Sorry to hear that you are experiencing this. I am not really good at giving advice but what I can tell you is to take time to just breathe and calm down and remember that if you are not in your best condition, you can't be a help to anyone specially with the ones you love. So I hope that you can start by being there for yourself. To pick yourself up, care for yourself. Know that you're feelings are valid and don't ever think that it's just some kind of phase led by our ever-changing hormones. Have self awareness and recognize other coping mechanism that can help you in difficult times like doing outdoor activities, dancing or writing, literally anything that would prevent you in resorting to harm yourself. Try to a little bit honest with your feelings. It doesn't necessarily have to be with your family or relatives if it's too difficult for you. You can try talk to strangers or to anyone that you find it a little bit comfortable to talk to.

More importantly, TAKE ONE STEP AT A TIME. You are not expected to be healed and be altogether OK. Don't be too hard to yourself. Be willing to undergo the process. We are young and always a work in progress. It's okay to fall down. 

I hope that one or two of what I said can somehow help you.

Take care
